title: Edit Videos With Dreamina Seedance 2.0
description:
Dreamina Seedance 2.0 is live on Dreamina, with no queuing required for immediate, high-speed access.

Dreamina is an in-house developed AI product by ByteDance. It shares the same parent company as TikTok, and the R&D team behind Dreamina Seedance 2.0 is part of Dreamina.

Dreamina Seedance 2.0 secured the No. 1 spot across all three Arena leaderboards: text-to-video, image-to-video, and video editing. Regardless of the influx of new models, it currently maintains an absolute competitive edge.

I tested it by using Omni Reference to change an existing video with a reference image and a prompt, while keeping the subject and motion consistent.

Prompt is in the comments.

#dreamina #dreaminapartner #seedance #dreaminaseedance2 #seedream

top_comments.text:
Use [reference video 1] (example: a clip of a man standing by a pool) as the main reference, and use [reference image 1] (example: a volcano scene with black rock, smoke, and lava) as the visual reference for the new environment or look.

Keep the [main subject] (example: the man) unchanged in [what should stay consistent] (example: appearance, proportions, clothing, and full-body framing).

Replace [what should change from the original scene] (example: the poolside setting and water) with [new environment or visual change] (example: a volcanic setting with black volcanic rock, smoke, and an active lava pool) based on [reference image 1].

Keep the [camera elements to preserve] (example: original camera angle, camera motion, framing, and timing) from [reference video 1].

The action should be: [describe the sequence of events] (example: the man stands at the edge, then jumps into the lava, and the lava splashes up and completely covers him).

Make sure the result feels [desired style or realism level] (example: cinematic, realistic, dramatic, and visually believable).
